==English==

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|water course}}; equivalent to {{com|en|water|course}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈwɔːtə(ɹ)ˌkɔː(ɹ)s/}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-watercourse.wav|a=Southern England}}

===Noun===
